QuickLookBridge_PluginDesc: Experimental: whenever an external QuickLook (github.com/QL-Win/QuickLook) instance is reachable over its own named pipe, it takes over previews for everything, ahead of every built-in preview provider. Lertaro's own preview panel hides itself while this is active, and QuickLook's separate floating window is docked into the exact spot that panel would have occupied.
QuickLookBridge_ActionDesc: Opens the selected file or folder in QuickLook's own preview window, over its named pipe.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_QuickLookPreviewProvide: Detects a reachable QuickLook instance over its named pipe, hands off every preview to it, hides Lertaro's own preview panel while it's active, and docks QuickLook's window into that panel's spot.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_QuickLookBridgeTranslat: Provides UI translation and localization mapping for the QuickLook Bridge plugin.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_PreviewInQuickLookActio: Manually triggers a QuickLook preview for the selected result over its named pipe.
